CHECKMULT appears in 0 corpus instances (harmless). 358 instances have count>1 and AtLeast covers them. The 'Words("requires <item>")' fallback for an unresolved item differs from PCGen, which fails a prereq naming an object that does not exist, but the unresolved items are un-ingested Backgrounds and parameterised feats, so Words is the honest product state.
verdicts.fix: keep; add: an item that resolves to no rule id is a converter defect-list entry (not a per-record rule); the 543 parameterised-feat misses need the base-feat + option id decision named in the row's open question before conversion

verdicts.reason: 4,708 / 4,027 records / 2,605 non-DONE (lane 2,729, 4.5%). PreMultTester.java:39-61 sums sub-clause passes and compares with the operator; pre_tokens.rs::evaluate_mult (line 974) is the three-valued extension the row describes, verified in source. 327 [redacted PI] bodies confirmed (327 instances / 326 records).

Four independent defects. (1) Semantics: PCGen's value of a variable is DEFINE seed + the SUM of every BONUS:VAR contribution on objects the character holds (PlayerCharacter.java:2090-2140 getVariable -> getTotalBonusTo("VAR")). 543 of the 1,244 top-level level-alias instances name a variable with more than one distinct setter formula -- BloodlineCasterLVL (258) is set by SorcererLVL, MagusLVL, DragonDiscipleLVL and -BloodragerLVL on four different records; RogueTalentLVL (53) by RogueLVL, NinjaLVL, BardLVL, SwashbucklerLVL, AspisAgentLVL and TL -- so 'resolves to ClassLevel(C)' is wrong for them; the value is the formula lane's G1 sum over held contributors. (2) Index scope: the rule builds its setter index 'over every DEFINE:/BONUS:VAR in the corpus'; 307 top-level instances (239 names, KiPowerLVL 22, the *ManifestationLevel family) are DEFINE-only in corpus raw_tokens with their BONUS:VAR setters in un-ingested rows, and 187 more (EidolonTempEvolutionPool 120, set at apg_abilities_companion.lst) have setters only in the pinned tree -- a corpus-only index classifies all 494 as flags with no setter. (3) No rule for a name with no setter anywhere (69 top-level instances, 21 names: MHMercyLVL 15, NotAllowed 10, ClericLvl 9 -- a typo of ClericLVL): PCGen evaluates an unknown identifier as 0 (VariableProcessor.java:395-403, 'Don't care, as it's just zero'), so PREVARGTEQ:MHMercyLVL,N is decided false; anything that becomes Words there includes what PCGen excludes and fails the row's own SA.<n>.NAME parity oracle. (4) Evidence: the 52% level-alias figure (2,666 of 5,118) is not reproducible -- by setter shape it is 24.4% (1,244 of 5,108); 45% if every if()-conditioned LVL variable is counted; the row admits it was classified by name pattern. MasterLevel (209 top-level instances) is listed as a level alias; it is the companion master's level (bonus E7 / formula G11), not any ClassLevel.
verdicts.fix: resolve(var) := Expr::Var(id) over the converter-emitted contribution table (formula lane G1 form B), built from the pinned-tree closure (build_mod_index's walk), never from corpus raw_tokens alone; collapse to ClassLevel(X) only when the name has exactly one setter formula and it is CL/classlevel("X")/TL; a name with no setter anywhere -> Const(0) and a defect-list line (never Words); a flag whose every setter is a constant on a rule record -> AtLeast{1,[Holds{setter}...]} as the row says; MasterLevel -> the companion-master gap, Words until it exists. Re-state the split with the setter-shape classifier and its denominators.

verdicts.reason: 506 / 402 non-DONE hold. The 'pool counters stay Words until Expr::ChoiceCount exists' rule is unnecessary: TempEvolutionTaken (120) and AnimalCompanionSkill (90) are ordinary cross-record variables whose contributors are `BONUS:VAR|TempEvolutionTaken|1` addends on the held evolution rules (PlayerCharacter.getVariable sums them); with the formula lane's Var table they are Compare{Var(id) < rhs}, no new variant. verdicts.reason: 304 / 256 hold; UsePathfinderUnchainedSkills 17 + UseConsolidatedSkills 7 = 24 as stated. The flag shapes are right (VigilanteIsZealot, EidolonSubtype_* have one constant setter each). Two shapes the paragraph does not name still resolve through the general rule: level-alias equality (OracleLVL 14, MonkLVL 9 -- Compare{Var == n}) and multi-setter flags (HunterSkirmisherAnimalTrick 26 -> AtLeast). design_verdict_three_valued_applies.question: Is three-valued logic necessary, or does it hide per-record judgment?
design_verdict_three_valued_applies.verdict: Not necessary; it hides two per-record leaks and contradicts the family's own oracle.
design_verdict_three_valued_applies.evidence: PCGen's every prerequisite test returns pass/fail (PreMultTester.java:39-61 counts integer passes; PreTextTester passes unconditionally; an unknown variable is 0 at VariableProcessor.java:395-403). The lane's Words leaf arises in exactly three situations: (i) genuinely situational gates that PCGen itself passes or that name equipped state -- PRETEXT 168 (+236 in feat lists), PREARMORTYPE 1, PREEQUIP 2, PREDR 1, PREHANDSGTEQ 1, PREREACHGTEQ 1, PREVARNEQ 4 (< 450 instances); (ii) character facts the product lacks -- alignment (PREALIGN 141, !PREALIGN 37, DOMAINS-with-PREALIGN 452), deity (50 + 37 + 8), gender 3, age 2, base size 41, spells known 16+10+1 -- which PCGen settles per character; (iii) variables the lane's corpus-only setter index cannot resolve (494 top-level PREVAR* instances with setters outside corpus raw_tokens, 69 with none anywhere) -- which PCGen settles to a number. In (ii) and (iii) the same token type yields filter on one record and Words on the next, so 'resolvability' is a per-record outcome wearing a per-type label. On the printed sheet, Words=include holds and prints unearned rules: 71 AUTOMATIC/VIRTUAL grants on 47 records carry a fact-gap or situational gate today.
design_verdict_three_valued_applies.recommendation: Two-valued Applies plus an explicit Situational{text} marker for class (i) (bonus lane's G-situational: the condition is words on that rule's line). Class (ii) becomes a named fact-gap blocker list with unit counts, not a Words verdict. Class (iii) is fixed by building the setter index from the pinned-tree closure and mapping no-setter names to Const(0) (PCGen's value). Until a fact lands, an AUTOMATIC grant gated on it must be treated as not-held (or printed with its condition as words), never silently held.
